results.name: Akira Ransomware
results.description:
Akira is swiftly becoming one of the fastest-growing ransomware families thanks to its use of double extortion tactics, a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) distribution model, and unique payment options. Akira ransomware emerged in March 2023 and has been known to target companies based in the US and Canada.
Akira appears to be based on the Conti ransomware: It shares similar routines with Conti, such as string obfuscation and file encryption, and avoids the same file extensions that Conti avoids. The Akira RaaS group performs double extortion tactics and steals victims’ critical data prior to encrypting devices and files. Its Tor leak site has a unique retro look that, according to a report from Sophos, is reminiscent of “1980s green-screen consoles” that can be navigated by typing specific commands. Akira operators provide victims the option to pay for either file decryption or data deletion. Ransom demands for Akira typically range from $200,000 USD to over $4 million USD.

新型Akira勒索软件家族攻击战术公开
results.description: Akira勒索软件于2023年3月首次出现，是一种快速增长的勒索软件家族，它采用了双重勒索策略、勒索软件即服务（RaaS）分发模式和独特的付款选项。Akira勒索软件组织似乎与现已解散的Conti勒索软件团伙有联系。安全人员表示，该勒索软件虽然与2017年出现的Akira勒索软件家族同名且加密后缀相同，但是两者的源码完全不同，因此判断二者并非同一家族。该新型Akira软件基于Conti勒索软件，实施双重勒索策略，其攻击目的主要是获取经济利益。

ACTIVIDAD MALICIOSA | Relacionada con Akira Stealer 22-10-2023
results.description: Akira Stealer es un malware que se enfoca en robar información confidencial de sistemas comprometidos y se distribuye en un modelo de "Malware como Servicio", lo que lo hace peligroso tanto para organizaciones como para usuarios individuales. La mejor forma de protegerse contra este tipo de amenazas es ser cauteloso con enlaces y archivos sospechosos, mantener el software de seguridad actualizado y seguir prácticas de seguridad sólidas.
